messages:
lucy: opened a tiny docs PR to clarify rounding for lots of tiny embedding calls + add an SDK header example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234

ben: Can you paste the repro and the exact header you want shown? I'll check accuracy and console links.

lucy: Repro in PR: several near-simultaneous single-vector embedding requests get grouped into micro-batches; metering sums per-batch then applies tier rounding, so billed units can differ from naive per-call rounding. Proposed fix: short table + a 'When to request per-call billing' blurb.

tara: Suggest we show the header as `x-redwood-billing-intent: per-call` and add a one-liner for the JS SDK. Also update the console pointer (Console path changed last month).

lucy: Added compact JS + curl snippets in the PR and updated console reference to "Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering (panel: Tiering by unit type)".

infra-bot: Note: runtime ticket RUNTIME-811 created to surface billing-intent header in metering events for audits.

ben: Quick copy edits: replace "opt out" with "request per-call semantics" and shorten the table. Looks good to me.

docs-bot: PR opened by lucy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234 labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

tara: I'll do a final pass this afternoon and merge if no issues.

lucy: thanks all — leaving thread open for any last-minute notes.
